name_zh: 格陵兰冰盖/气候科学：极地气候韧性与冰芯记忆
name_en: Greenland Ice Sheet/Climate Science: Polar Climate Resilience & Ice Core Memory
description_zh: 格陵兰冰盖 170 万平方公里/冰芯钻探(NGRIP/NEEM/EGRIP/东格陵兰)/10 万年气候记录/青年德里亚斯/末次冰期/全新世/海平面上升/IPCC 关键数据/融化加速/2012/2019 极端融化/格陵兰气候研究中心/哥本哈根大学/阿尔弗雷德·韦格纳研究所。核心模式：极地气候韧性 — 冰芯记忆/融化监测/海平面预测/适应工程/北极放大效应/全球气候正义。体现 M178 极地气候韧性 — 以"冰芯记忆+融化监测+海平面预测+适应工程"四位一体，在不可逆融化/全球海平面/北极放大/气候正义四重挑战中构建极地气候治理范式。
description_en: Greenland Ice Sheet 1.7M km2/ice core drilling (NGRIP/NEEM/EGRIP/East Greenland)/100k year climate record/Younger Dryas/Last Glacial Maximum/Holocene/sea level rise/IPCC key data/accelerating melt/2012/2019 extreme melt/Greenland Climate Research Centre/University of Copenhagen/AWI. Core model: polar climate resilience — ice core memory/melt monitoring/sea level prediction/adaptation engineering/Arctic amplification/global climate justice. Exemplifies M178 Polar Climate Resilience — quaternity of 'ice core memory + melt monitoring + sea level prediction + adaptation engineering' building polar climate governance paradigm amid quadruple challenges of irreversible melt/global sea level/Arctic amplification/climate justice.
reason_zh: 格陵兰冰盖非单纯冰川，而是"冰芯记忆+融化监测+海平面命脉"三位一体全球气候调节器。冰芯编码 10 万年气候历史，融化直接威胁全球沿海城市，北极放大效应加速全球变暖。M178 区隔于 M188 山地生态(乞力马扎罗)、M204 气候生存(斐济)、M208 极地自治(格陵兰自治)，核心在于"冰芯即气候档案+融化即海平面命脉+北极放大即全球加速器"的极地气候治理范式。
reason_en: Greenland Ice Sheet not mere glacier but 'ice core memory + melt monitoring + sea level lifeline' trinity global climate regulator. Ice cores encode 100k year climate history, melt directly threatens global coastal cities, Arctic amplification accelerates global warming. M178 distinct from M188 Mountain Ecology (Kilimanjaro), M204 Climate Survival (Fiji), M208 Polar Autonomy (Greenland autonomy), core: 'ice cores as climate archive + melt as sea level lifeline + Arctic amplification as global accelerator' polar climate governance paradigm.
